title: Render a onepagr one-pager to PDF — render_onepager
text: data Named list whisker substitution values. alert-style templates (overdose_spike_alert, syndromic_alert), severity_level token must literal lowercase string "warning" "critical", show_* toggle token (e.g. show_resources, show_cluster) must literal lowercase string "true" "false". substituted directly Typst string comparisons, R logical (whisker coerces "TRUE"/"FALSE", uppercase) value fails compile loudly Typst panic() rather silently rendering wrong severity styling mis-toggled section. template Character. built-template name (see list_templates()). theme Character. built-theme name, path custom theme .typ file (see resolve_theme()). Default "default". theme_path Character NULL. Explicit theme file path override; supplied, theme ignored. Default NULL. output Character. Path write compiled PDF . keep_typst Logical. Whether leave resolved .typ tree next output (TRUE, default) use disposable tempdir (FALSE). extra_assets Character vector file paths stage compile work directory alongside theme/components/package assets – per-run generated images (e.g. charts/maps produced fresh calling script) template's #image() calls need reference. Typst's compiler sandboxes file access directory compiled rejects absolute filesystem paths outright (confirmed directly: #image("C:/abs/path/map.png") fails compile "path contains invalid component" even fixing Windows backslashes forward slashes – path-syntax issue, Typst permit escaping compile root ). file copied basename (overwriting conflict); pass just basename corresponding whisker token's value (e.g. extra_assets = "path//map0.png" pairs template token value "map0.png", original full path). Default character(0) (extra assets, e.g. templates whose images static package assets).

text: Five built-templates, genuinely distinct informational shape: cohort_summary: contrasts two groups point time. trend_snapshot: tracks one metric across several time periods. overdose_spike_alert: anomaly/threshold alert bulletin (ODMAP-style), natural pagination. syndromic_alert: anomaly/threshold alert syndrome (ESSENCE-style), natural pagination. county_choropleth: geographic bivariate comparison across counties, supports per-run generated map images via extra_assets.
